title: Candy/Confectionery
content: Apply candy/confectionery aesthetic with sweet deliciousness. Pastel and bright candy colors: pink, mint, yellow, lavender. Include candy and dessert imagery: lollipops, cupcakes, ice cream. Sprinkle patterns and textures. Glossy, glazed surfaces. Dripping frosting and chocolate effects. Striped candy patterns. Sweet, playful, indulgent atmosphere.

variants.simple: Create sweet candy aesthetic with sugary colors, dessert motifs, and delicious playfulness.
variants.detailed: Apply candy/confectionery aesthetic with sweet deliciousness. Pastel and bright candy colors: pink, mint, yellow, lavender. Include candy and dessert imagery: lollipops, cupcakes, ice cream. Sprinkle patterns and textures. Glossy, glazed surfaces. Dripping frosting and chocolate effects. Striped candy patterns. Sweet, playful, indulgent atmosphere.
variants.advanced: Apply candy/confectionery aesthetic with sweet, delicious playfulness. Color palette: candy pastels and brights - bubblegum pink (#ffc0cb), mint (#98ff98), lemon yellow (#fffacd), lavender (#e6e6fa), candy red (#ff6b6b), chocolate brown (#7b3f00), cream (#fffef0). Candy types: lollipops (swirl patterns), gummy textures (translucent, glossy), hard candy (shiny, faceted), cotton candy (fluffy, pastel). Dessert motifs: cupcakes, donuts, ice cream cones, macarons, cookies - as illustrations or icons. Sprinkles: scattered elongated shapes in rainbow colors, as pattern or decoration. Texture effects: glazed/glossy surfaces (gradient highlights), frosting texture (soft peaks), chocolate drip (smooth, shiny brown). Stripes: candy cane diagonal stripes, circus tent stripes. Dripping: liquid effects on edges - frosting, chocolate, glaze dripping down (SVG or CSS). Typography: rounded, friendly, playful fonts (Bubblegum Sans, Fredoka One), can have frosting/candy decoration. Polka dots: large colorful dots pattern (gumball/jawbreaker reference). Wrapper aesthetic: twisted candy wrapper ends on elements. Bite marks: elements can have bites taken out. Interactive: lick/bite effects on hover, sprinkles falling, bouncy animations. Sound suggested: crunch, squish, wrapper crinkle. Photography: macro candy shots, bright lighting. Implementation: gradients for glossy effects, SVG for shapes. Accessibility: bright colors need contrast checking, playful aesthetic shouldnt compromise usability.
